product.name: Monoprice 5.25in 2-Way Indoor/Outdoor Weatherproof Speakers 40W Nominal 80W Max (Pair)
product.description: What's better than a warm summer day than lounging by the pool with some burgers and hotdogs cooking on the BBQ and a cool drink in your hand? How about all of the above plus some high-quality speakers from Monoprice filling the air with some sweet, sweet music?You don't have to put your speakers in the window to get good music in the back yard, nor do you have to settle for low-fidelity portable stereos. These all-weather, indoor/outdoor speakers from Monoprice are a perfect, hassle-free way to get your music outside, even when it rains.Each 5-1/4" coaxially-mounted, 2-way speaker array produces high quality sound in a compact, water-proof package. They can handle up to 40 watts per channel (RMS) and a maximum of 80 watts per channel at 8 ohms. The compact design is easy to mount to a wall, a pole, or any other vertical surface.Features: 5-1/4" polypropylene + mica injection cone woofer1/2" PEI dome tweeter with ferrofluidUV resistant cabinet96-hour salt spray testedIP-55 ingress protection ratingAluminum grillIncludes mounting brackets                       Warning: This product can expose you to Phthalates, which is known to the State of California to cause cancer and reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
